_comment: Pack config for import_kenney.py. zone: 1=R 2=C 3=I. mode controls density bucketing: 'all-low' puts every building in bucket 0 (suburban = houses only); 'height' splits buildings into buckets 0/1/2 by Z-height tertiles; 'height+sky' = like height but any name containing 'skyscraper' is forced to bucket 2. Only files whose basename starts with 'building' are imported (skips detail-/low-detail-/chimney/fence/tree/etc props).
